provider_prompt_policy: Original complete prompt7 remains unchanged; recovery-1 is a bounded failure-recovery job identity, not a new analysis prompt.
deadline_rule: New dispatch/first CLAIM require both batch cutoff+72h and bound-review deadline in the future. Cached reads/progress remain readable. Manual staging expiry must not exceed this bound-review deadline.
eligibility: Only the exact original prompt7 job with matching packet hash/symbol/cutoff, FAILED + exact STOCK_AI_PROVIDER_HTTP_429 + attempts3. All72 original jobs must be COMPLETE or satisfy this exhausted429 condition before paid work.
global_stop: A pending receipt or active recovery RUNNING prevents another target. Any FAILED stops the entire batch; expired RUNNING is STOPPED_UNKNOWN and is never reclaimed. A completed target allows one separately reviewed manual next dispatch.
review_document_hash_policy: Operation-authorization binding only. It is not automatic quality/time/licensing/source-use PASS and creates no ai_research_reviews or publication events.

new_functions.signature: public.daily_stock_ai_rate_limit_recovery_job_v1(text, text, text, text, text, text, jsonb, jsonb, uuid, text)

progress_policy: Original COMPLETE wins per symbol; otherwise only receipted recovery COMPLETE contributes its real immutable job key. No raw results; count/key set must cover all72 before existing operator staging.
rollback_policy: Refuse DROP when any recovery receipt or any recovery-1 job exists, including FAILED/RUNNING/unknown. Separately disable EXECUTE and retain historical records if work has started.
historical_attempts_note: The previously observed182 attempts/transports are not182 successful billed calls. Actual charges associated with429 responses are unknown.

tests.results: Synthetic local analyses and provider receipts; no model/network/production call
tests.expiry_clock: An isolated WASM clock is advanced only for expiry-negative tests

limitations: New recovery jobs require the separately implemented exact worker path.
A single isolated PostgreSQL/WASM connection does not prove production lock-wait timing or capacity.
Existing queued/direct Edge and citation-repair paths are separate; original jobs are never reset.
